newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in slow late trading on Monday, with few enquiries heard, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices remained at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"We've got several fresh bids from Europe at 54.00, but we have no deals yet because the bids are just too low. We, however, expect to secure deals later today," one dealer in Jakarta said.
He said sellers were likely to eventually lower their offer prices by 0.25-0.50 cents/lb due to an expected poor demand.
February SIR20 was last traded at 55.00 fob Palembang and Surabaya on Thursday, but the quantity was relatively small as the purchases were for short-covering, dealers said.
